metadata.case_name: WONG CHUN CHIN v. SUN SHING CONSTRUCTION CO (A FIRM) AND ANOTHER [1998]

injuries.description: Prolapsed disc at L4/5 and L5/S1
source: MRI scan at United Christian Hospital on 19 May 1995 revealed prolapsed disc L4/5 and L5/S1.
injuries.icd_description: Certain specified injuries of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: Post-operative scarring and residual disc causing nerve root compression/irritation (extra dural compression at L4/5)
injuries.body_part: nerve root at L4/5 / lower back
source: the subsequent operation he described as unsuccessful as it produced excessive scarring, resulting in irritation to the nerve root.
Dr. Cheng said that on 2 February 1996 scans revealed extra dural compression at L4/5 level and a possibility of residual disc inside the affected area.
the MRI scans revealed that the scarring was exerting pressure on the nerve.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: severe right leg pain radiating from buttock to heel
weakness due to nerve damage; muscle weakness and wasting of muscle bulk
numbness in the right lower limb, especially the big toe
mild numbness over the left big toe
inability to bend properly; cannot carry more than about 20 pounds

treatments_received: examination and x-rays at United Christian Hospital
referral to Kwun Tong Jockey Club Clinic
Fenestration and Posterior Discectomy L4/5 and L5/S1
sick leave certificates and sick pay
treatments_future: recommended major corrective operation (declined by plaintiff)

losses.description: Permanent residual disability of the lower back with nerve root compression causing persistent pain, numbness, weakness, muscle wasting and limitation in bending and lifting.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Pui-ki v. Leung On and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: serious injury; range of compensation for serious injury $400,000 - $540,000

comparable_cases.case_name: Lai Wah Wai v. Castco Testing Centre Ltd.
comparable_cases.injury_description: prolapsed disc and nerve root compression from a construction site injury; fenestration and discectomy with residual fibrosis but no nerve compression at that stage; residual disability including inability to lift heavy weights and backache on sitting, standing and walking for longer than 30 minutes
